xs.$description: New token (2026-10-26), added for Stepper's step indicator: its diameter at each size step. The spacing scale has no 28px, and 24px is the target-size floor for a step that can be entered.

label-max-width.$description: New token (2026-10-27), added for Stepper's step text: the widest a step's title and description may grow in a horizontal stepper before they wrap, so a long title does not stretch its step or its column. No home on any existing primitive scale (the spacing scale tops out at 8rem).
